## Positioning

Tejas Karan Agrawal is the rare hire who actually owns BOTH ends of growth: the campaign + creative + paid-media motion, AND the AI/automation stack underneath it. The combination is unusual — most "AI marketers" don't have an 8-year paid-media track record; most paid-media operators don't build production agents. Tejas does both.

Hire-fit summary:
- **Strong fit:** founder-led DTC brand needing a growth lead who can scale paid + build internal automation; AI-first agency needing a performance lead who actually ships agent code; growth-tooling startup needing a product-marketer-operator.
- **Weak fit:** single-channel media-buyer seats (you'd be paying for skills he won't use); deep enterprise B2B SaaS (his depth is DTC/SMB).

## Operating bona fides

- **2 crore+ INR in total sales generated** scaling a dropshipping store from launch, selling the store to the vendor, then expanding the operation to 4 stores with paid + ops + retention.
- **4 e-commerce stores built and operated** across product testing, paid traffic, supplier coordination, customer support, automation, post-purchase + WhatsApp retention.

- **2 Canadian digital marketing diplomas** layered on top.

## Detailed role history

### Dropshipping / Ecom Specialist — Urban Classics Store (June 2023 – present, India / Remote)
Began with one store; scaled it on Meta/TikTok paid; sold to the vendor; helped expand the operation to 4 stores. Practical full-loop growth: product testing → store setup → ad campaigns → supplier coordination → support → conversion feedback. Moved repetitive commerce work into automated flows including post-purchase and WhatsApp retention.

### Performance Marketing Specialist — Quickads (October 2025 – March 2026, Texas, USA)
Performance shop environment while studying in Canada. Contributed to campaign + creative workflows for brands including Udemy and Night Habit. Sharpened interest in AI-first marketing operations and faster testing systems.

### Digital Marketing Specialist — IndoFolk Wellness (January 2025 – June 2025, India)
Supported USA + Canada Shopify launches with paid social strategy, creative coordination, campaign reporting for wellness commerce. TikTok marketing strategies; performance-oriented ad creative collaboration with designers; campaign-data → conversion-rate iteration.

### Content Specialist — CableCommunity (August 2021 – February 2022, Delhi)
Owned content + SEO + social distribution for renewable energy and electric vehicle topics. Daily blog content strategy; technical articles + keyword-rich snippets for topical authority; on-page + off-page SEO; social channel management routing readers back to the site.

### Founder — Rcube Biotech & Energy LLP (November 2020 – August 2021, Gwalior, MP)
Innovation venture around Smart Bio-Toilet Bed and Smart Bio-Toilet Chair products for disabled and paralyzed people. First-of-its-kind product concept in India taken from idea to positioned product.

### Digital Marketing Executive — Digistreet Infocom (January 2019 – June 2020, Greater Noida)
Real-estate lead-gen focus. Managed social + PPC for lead gen; SEO/organic traffic for the company website; managed a 4-person team as the company's first hire.
